npcs.name: Mara Vell
npcs.motive: Find her missing salvage crew before the storm hits. She doesn't trust the party but needs muscle.
npcs.detail: Carries a cracked brass signal lens. Notices J'Epstein's copper allergy immediately and swaps her brass lens for a steel one. 'I've seen stranger.'

npcs.name: Osric Vale
npcs.motive: Wants to short-change the party. Deeply regrets taking Shlomo's contract terms.
npcs.detail: Visibly nervous around Shlomo. Keeps recounting the coin pouch. Whispers 'that hobgoblin knows something.' Mista has already seen through three of his lies.

npcs.name: Sella Morn
npcs.motive: Warn the party about the tide patterns. 'The water is wrong. It's been wrong for four days. It's listening.'
npcs.detail: Old woman with salt-crusted robes. Stares at J'Epstein too long. 'You already know what the water can do, don't you, cat?'

npcs.name: Parrot (unnamed)
npcs.motive: Escape. Scream. Bite. Repeat. Secretly the smartest creature in the party.
npcs.detail: Hostile, intelligent, perpetually furious. Screams words in languages nobody taught it. Has started screaming coordinates.
